metric_definitions.hybrid_exact_action_match: Compare final controller action type, tool name, and complete expected arguments against dataset labels; for no-tool actions compare type and absence of a tool only.
metric_definitions.task_completion: Not measured by this offline action-level evaluator; no database tools are executed here.
metric_definitions.estimated_model_calls_for_hybrid_path: Controller preflight decisions are counted as zero; other valid proposals count one. The paired raw model artifact still queried every example to provide model-only evidence.
metric_definitions.controller_duration: Local time to run preflight and controller policy over saved proposals; excludes database execution and model inference.
